title.zh: 不等式 · 天平倾斜，答案是一整段
title.en: Inequalities · A Tilted Scale Has a Whole Range of Answers

desc.zh: 天平不平的时候，答案不是一个数而是一段范围：在数轴上涂阴影，乘负数时要把不等号翻过来。
desc.en: When the scale tilts, the answer is a range, not one number: shade it on the number line, and flip the sign when you multiply by a negative.
